title: A Polish Electroencephalography, Alzheimer’s Risk-genes, Lifestyle and Neuroimaging (PEARL-Neuro) Database
description: The PEARL-Neuro Database contains EEG, fMRI, genetic, health, and lifestyle data from 192 healthy middle-aged (50-63) Polish individuals at risk of Alzheimer's disease, based on APOE and PICALM genotypes. A subgroup of 79 participants also underwent neuroimaging (EEG and fMRI) during resting-state and cognitive task protocols (multi-source interference task and Sternberg's memory task), alongside blood test data. The dataset aims to support research on genetic, lifestyle, and neuroimaging correlates of dementia risk in middle-aged adults.
methods_description: Data were collected via EEG and fMRI during resting-state protocols (eyes open and eyes closed conditions) and cognitive tasks (multi-source interference task and Sternberg's memory task). Genetic data (APOE, PICALM) and psychometric assessments (memory, intelligence, mood, personality, stress coping) were also obtained, alongside blood tests (blood count, lipid profile, HSV virus).
